label: Monolithic Shiva Vimana & Shikhara (Central Spire)
description: Monumental 3-storey monolithic Dravidian spire rising 32 meters from the courtyard floor, carved top-down from a single basalt cliff. Features elaborate tiers of miniature pavilions (kutas and salas), topped by an octagonal domical shikhara.

iconography.period: Rashtrakuta dynasty, reign of Krishna I (c. 756-773 CE)
iconography.thematic_meaning: Represents Mount Kailash, the cosmic terrestrial axis and mythical abode of Lord Shiva.

label: Monolithic Nandi Mandapa & Entry Pavilion
description: Two-storey detached square pavilion sheltering the sacred bull Nandi, facing the sanctum. Connected to the main temple by a rock-cut footbridge across the courtyard.

iconography.thematic_meaning: Nandi symbolizes steadfast devotion, waiting eternally in contemplation of Shiva.
